configuration.title: Codex SwitchBridge
configuration.proxy.description: Machine-only HTTP or HTTPS proxy for ChatGPT quota requests. This setting is excluded from Settings Sync. Leave empty to use VS Code's http.proxy setting, then the extension-host proxy environment.
configuration.quotaRefreshInterval.descr: Background maintenance interval, in seconds. Each interval checks one saved account for token refresh when enabled and refreshes one saved account quota in rotation.
configuration.tokenAutoUpdate.descriptio: Automatically refresh saved account tokens during background timer maintenance when the token is expired or close to expiring.
configuration.autoSwitchOnZeroQuota.desc: Automatically switch away from the currently selected saved account when its 5-hour quota reaches 0%, but only if another saved account has freshly confirmed 5-hour quota remaining.
Minimum time to wait before retrying automatic switching for the same exhausted account after no eligible replacement was found or a switch attempt failed.
configuration.shareHistoryAcrossProvider: Keep new local Codex conversation history available across account mode and Responses-compatible API-provider modes. Enabled by default; run Repair Shared Conversation History once for older provider-tagged threads.
configuration.showStatusBar.description: Show the current account quota in the status bar
configuration.detailedPerformanceLogging: Debug-only. Emit performance logs for account list refresh and quota operations.
configuration.reloadWindowAfterSwitch.de: How VS Code window reload should be handled after switching accounts or API providers
configuration.reloadWindowAfterSwitch.en: Do not show a reload recommendation or reload the window after switching
Show a clickable Reload recommended item in the status bar without interrupting your work
Always reload the window after switching so the Codex extension can re-read auth
configuration.authDirectory.description: Directory used to save and load auth_{name}.json files. Leave empty to use the default Codex config directory.
configuration.useDeviceAuthForLogin.desc: Use `codex login --device-auth` for add/re-login. Enable this only after turning on device code authorization for Codex in ChatGPT Security Settings.
configuration.defaultSaveTarget.descript: Default storage target used when saving accounts or API-provider profiles.
configuration.defaultSaveTarget.enum.loc: Save new accounts and API providers to local files by default
configuration.defaultSaveTarget.enum.clo: Save new accounts and API providers to synced extension storage by default
configuration.syncedStorage.markdownDepr: Legacy migration-only setting. Cloud data now lives in synced extension storage managed by the extension.
configuration.syncedStorage.description: Legacy migration-only backup of encrypted cloud accounts and API providers. Managed internally by the extension.
